items.title: Dolly Douroux Adams Interview, 1962-04-18
items.q: I can only remember... One, he was a bass player. He was Charlie DeBurgis. ... I do remember hearing my daddy play, say that Charlie DeBurgis played with them. ... that was a little before my time. I mean, I was too young to even have an interest in it

ctx.x: Do you remember any particular dance band groups that he might have worked with?
Well, I can only remember... One, he was a bass player. He was Charlie DeBurgis.
Oh, yes. Professor Mineta studied, took lessons from him. He did? He must have taught and played different instruments. He most had it.
